page.overview:
What is Olderion?

Olderion is a continent in the world of Lapis, featured in Final Fantasy Brave Exvius. Home to the Olderion Federation, the continent houses the Water Crystal in the Water Shrine.

Olderion is home to the espers Carbuncle and Leviathan; the latter is revered as the "water god" by the inhabitants of Olderion.
